closed_invariants: Action-scope closure does not auto-close Promise scope.
Accepted Action return still requires the Promise's own remaining contract conditions.
Promise-scope closure does not auto-close Project scope.
Project closes only when every Project-scope required result is accepted.
Parent closure is reached through returned results plus parent contract re-evaluation, never by inheriting a Sub-Sequence terminal status.
Closed lower-scope Sequences remain immutable while higher scopes continue.
Sub-Sequence closure and required-return acceptance remain separate states.
scope_boundary: Synthetic ACTION -> PROMISE -> PROJECT closure hierarchy only.
